messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 17):
"""
Insurers may widen the scope of the product but in no case the scope of the product can be narrowed down. II. Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number: 1. “Ayushman Bharat Health Account” (ABHA) number is a hassle-free method of accessing and sharing health records digitally. It enables interaction with participating healthcare providers, and allows to receive digital lab reports, prescriptions and diagnosis seamlessly from verified healthcare professionals and health service providers. 2. With specific consent of the policyholder, Insurers may facilitate creation of ABHA number as per procedures laid down. 3. Further, express consent of the policyholder shall be obtained for sharing of medical records and any other related information in every instance. III. Submission of Returns:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Can an insurer create an Ayushman Bharat Health Account number for me without my explicit consent?","answer":"No, insurers must obtain specific consent from the policyholder before facilitating the creation of an ABHA number.","facts":["\"With specific consent of the policyholder, Insurers may facilitate creation of ABHA number as per procedures laid down.\""]},{"question":"Do I need to give separate consent each time my medical records are shared?","answer":"Yes, express consent of the policyholder must be obtained for sharing medical records and any other related information in every instance.","facts":["\"Further, express consent of the policyholder shall be obtained for sharing of medical records and any other related information in every instance.\""]}]}
